text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: âI must know. I have to gather the data.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"What will I be able to leave behind in 
the end?" In order to find the answer to 
that...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
“—That said, of course we shouldn't just 
gather information aimlessly.”

In fact, what I "want to know" is crystal 
clear. In short, it is about "inheritance 
among Umamusume," but—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Blood... I see. Indeed, when contemplating 
"inheritance," that is the simplest and 
most orthodox perspective.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Mother and I are living proof of that. The 
blood passed down from mother to daughter 
among Umamusume—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
What kind of soul, what kind of feelings 
resided there, and were passed down 
through the generations?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I'd very much like to... gather data from 
that perspective.
choice_data_list:
("Bloodline"... The first thing that comes 
to mind is...)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hmm. So, you came to me first... did you?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. She truly inherited her mother's 
feelings and strength, achieving a 
mother-daughter victory in the Oaks—"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
What kind of legacy was passed down 
between Air Groove-senpai and her mother? 
Could you please tell me about it?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Just as with you, my mother is the 
Umamusume I revere most of all. Thus, 
there is no end to what I have received 
from her, but—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Even so, if I were to name one defining 
quality. —I suppose it would be sheer 
spirit.

Repeating it to myself, it deeply 
resonates. That race where, in a nearly 
photo-finish line of contenders, she still 
seized the throne of the Queen of the 
Oaks—

"The spirit and grit her mother displayed 
there. Her powerful figure seizing glory 
no matter how fierce the battle was—"

They are firmly linked to the "Empress's" 
rapid rise, reaching beyond the confines 
of the Tiara route into races like the 
Tenno Sho (Autumn) and Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
What was inherited from her mother, passed 
down and connected to Air Groove-senpai... 
is none other than 'grit'—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Hm, but "bloodlines", is it? In that 
case—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
There are others you should hear from as 
well. ...Allow me to introduce the first 
one.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, are you quite sure...! Thank you 
very much!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I don't mind. Just make sure the two of 
you are fully prepared, got it?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
She's quite a troublesome opponent despite 
all that.

And so, following Air Groove's directions, 
the place we were headed to was—
(Vrroooom...!)

text_block_list.name: People in Black
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for waiting. Lady Air Messiah, <username>, 
please step aboard.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes...! Um, p-please take good care of 
me!

My head was spinning from everything that 
just happened, but I boarded the small jet 
with Air Messiah anyway.

Feeling humbled by the courteous in-flight 
service, crossing the skies at immense 
speed, and upon arrival... She was waiting 
in a castle, smiling with refined 
elegance.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Welcome! I give you my warmest greetings.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Or rather... I'm so sorry to make you 
come all this way out of the blue!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"With all the official duties I absolutely 
had to attend to over here piling up... I 
trust your flight was comfortable?"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes, um, it was very comfortable. 
...Erm.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Lady Fine Motion. Thank you for inviting 
me... I would love to hear what you have 
to say—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, please don't be so formal! I'd love 
to chat simply as fellow academy students.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
From Groove-san, and... also from Shakur♪ 
I hear about you all the time, 
Messiah-chan.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"It was about 'bloodlines', right? If 
there's anything I can share, I'd be glad 
to!"

And so, Fine Motion—the Tiara Umamusume 
who once conquered both the Shuka Sho and 
Queen Elizabeth II Cup undefeated—smiled 
nobly.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, if we were to rephrase it as 
"bloodline"... or perhaps "house."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
What my ancestors bestowed upon me would 
have to be, without a doubt, nobility.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
To be noble. To be pure. That is the 
destiny etched into my soul— and my 
mission.

Both Air Messiah and I gasped. Although 
Tracen Academy has many students from 
high-class backgrounds by its very nature—

Even among them, she is truly 
extraordinary. Fine Motion carries the 
royal bloodline of a certain foreign 
nation, after all...

And so, carrying expectations greater and 
heavier than anyone else's with absolute 
lightness—

Fine Motion's boundless, noble spirit 
propelled her all the way to the throne of 
an undefeated queen.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Now then... Hehe, truth be told, I'd love 
to chat more. But with the race coming up, 
I can't let you waste precious time.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Before we wrap up, though, would you 
allow me to introduce someone as well?"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"If we're talking about 'bloodlines', then 
yes, of course. The Umamusume you two 
should visit is—"

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Butler
text_block_list.text:
Miss Air Messiah, <username>. A warm welcome to you 
both.

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Butler
text_block_list.text:
Right this way, please. Lady Daiichi Ruby 
is awaiting you.

The castle was certainly overwhelming, but 
this place carries quite a heavy pressure 
of its own... Surrounded by a solemn 
atmosphere, I followed the guide deeper 
into the estate.

I see... Speaking of "blood"... The one 
Fine Motion introduced to me was—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much for taking the time to 
come out. Sharing the list of questions 
with us beforehand was also a tremendous 
help.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
N-No, not at all. I'm the one imposing on 
your valuable time, so...!

Watching Daiichi Ruby offer her solemn 
thanks makes me feel even more humbled. 
After all, she is the heir to the renowned 
'Splendid Clan'—

Wielding overwhelming influence even in 
political and financial circles, as well 
as achieving great feats in the racing 
world... the "bloodline" running through 
her veins is far too extraordinary.
choice_data_list:
Which is precisely why... I would love to 
hear your story.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: —About "blood" and "heritage," right?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Frankly speaking, it must be tradition.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
The "Splendid Clan" has built a storied 
history, allowing the blood—and the 
will—passed down from our great ancestors 
to shine brightly.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
All the more reason. The weight of that 
history flows through my very veins. The 
pride of weaving that tradition is etched 
within me without a doubt.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Tradition... That is the very strength 
passed down to Ruby-senpai――

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Yes.

And Daiichi Ruby made it shine in the form 
of "speed."

Her own history, marked by dominating the 
sprint division with victories in the 
Yasuda Kinen and the Sprinters Stakes, 
speaks for itself...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
We were able to hear... some deeply 
valuable insights from everyone, weren't 
we?
choice_data_list: We sure gathered a lot of data, didn't we?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Let's see—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(In their own ways, the succession is 
achieved... and they, too, will surely 
pass it on in kind.)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: (...—Then, what about me?)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: (What form of inheritance should I take—?)

Air Messiah remains silent. We've gathered 
data to some extent, but— perhaps we still 
need that final piece of the puzzle?

Thinking that, an idea suddenly came to 
mind, and I made a suggestion.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ! Meaning...?

Line Craft and Daring Heart have both 
announced their entry into the next race, 
the Victoria Mile.

"And competing with everything they've got 
is, in a way, the ultimate form of 
communication for Umamusume."
choice_data_list:
Go feel the very forms dwelling within 
them for yourself.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...! I see.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(Loving the Tiara, aspiring for the 
Tiara... With a resolve purer and more 
earnest than anyone's, Craft-san races 
ahead, bursting with brilliance.)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(To be worthy of the title "Queen," Heart 
is always striving higher, bravely facing 
any hardship that comes her way.)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(In the Classic year, we competed together 
to seize the once-in-a-lifetime, 
one-and-only glory of the Triple Tiara... 
My comrades-in-arms.)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(That's right. If I run with all of you, 
who I can clash against with all my might, 
whose strength I can truly feel more than 
anyone else's, then surely...)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure that I, too, can find my own 
unique way to carry the torch—!
